provider: OpenXLab 浦源 (Shanghai AI Lab) — model + dataset centers

free_tier.stated: Not published. The platform introduction describes the model center as building an object-storage layer for large files. Verbatim: '基于平台内的命令行工具，便于 AI 开发者上传和发布模型文件，搭建对象存储体系，提供大文件存储能力，快速上传下载功能，便于 AI 开发者进行模型存储' (object storage system providing large-file storage capability). The dataset center supports private datasets and public datasets. No numeric byte quota is published. Documentation pages returned HTTP 504 and upload pages contain no quota statement.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: No egress meter found; public models and datasets are anonymously downloadable. Reads are CDN-served. Unverified at the header level because model-detail pages timed out from this network.

tooling: Pip install openxlab, then first-party subcommands: `openxlab dataset upload-file`, `openxlab dataset upload-folder`, `openxlab model upload ..` with --dataset-repo/--source-path/--target-path. Python SDK mirrors the CLI (upload_file / upload_folder). Also git+LFS. Real, named, documented client. This passes the tooling filter cleanly.
chaining: Repos are per-user and per-org and free to create, so capacity is N repos. OpenXLab is the Shanghai AI Lab's public front door (InternLM, OpenDataLab datasets), so its per-repo sizes are already in the tens-of-GB range. Multiplying across accounts is easy but the per-account ceiling is unknown.
limits_note: Unverified. Uploads use a chunked SDK rather than a web form. Dataset upload supports files, directories, and archives with server-side auto-extraction (a 50 GB zip file extracts into a directory tree where extracted size may exceed the archive). No published per-file cap, retention period, or rate limit found.

identity_cost.detail: Email, plus likely +86 phone. Chinese platform, and prior rounds recorded the pans in this family demanding real-name verification.

reliability_note: Documentation endpoints returned multiple HTTP 504 responses and 25-second timeouts on opendatalab.com and openxlab.org.cn API paths on 2026-10-21. Model detail pages return HTTP 302 redirecting to login.

extras.agent_focus: New and up-and-coming competitors to Hugging Face and ModelScope, judged on the hard test the brief sets: a credible HF competitor must permit multi-TB objects and generous per-account storage, because model weights and datasets routinely run to hundreds of GB / TiB. Split into three classes — Chinese domestic hubs (HF is blocked there, so a separate ecosystem exists), Western MLOps artifact stores (W&B/Comet/ClearML/Lightning/Deep Lake), and dataset-publishing startups (Source Cooperative, Oxen, OpenDataLab). Excluded and not re-reported: Hugging Face, ModelScope, Kaggle, Civitai, Ollama, Replicate, DagsHub, OpenML, fal.ai, Baseten, Modal.
